mapper.select: SELECT pr.fee_type_id AS feeTypeId, ft.type_name AS feeTypeName, ft.type_code AS typeCode, COALESCE(SUM(pr.amount), 0) AS amount FROM payment_record pr LEFT JOIN fee_type ft ON pr.fee_type_id = ft.id WHERE pr.semester_id = #{semesterId} GROUP BY pr.fee_type_id, ft.type_name, ft.type_code ORDER BY pr.fee_type_id

SELECT c.id AS classId, c.class_name AS className, COALESCE(SUM(pr.amount), 0) AS amount FROM payment_record pr LEFT JOIN student s ON pr.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN class_info c ON s.class_id = c.id WHERE pr.semester_id = #{semesterId} GROUP BY c.id, c.class_name ORDER BY c.id

SELECT c.id AS classId, c.class_name AS className, ft.id AS feeTypeId, ft.type_name AS feeTypeName, ft.type_code AS typeCode, COALESCE(SUM(pr.amount), 0) AS amount FROM payment_record pr LEFT JOIN student s ON pr.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN class_info c ON s.class_id = c.id LEFT JOIN fee_type ft ON pr.fee_type_id = ft.id WHERE pr.semester_id = #{semesterId} GROUP BY c.id, c.class_name, ft.id, ft.type_name, ft.type_code ORDER BY c.id, ft.id
